rules.statement: The court has jurisdiction under Section 56 of the Debt Conciliation Ordinance without any condition precedent, but is barred from exercising such jurisdiction under other provisions.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) In terms of S. 14 of the Conciliation Board Act there was a condition precedent for the court to have jurisdiction, but as regards s. 56 of the Debt Conciliation Ordinance there is no such condition precedent attached to it, but there is an absolute bar to jurisdiction. (2) The want of jurisdiction is patent and not latent, objection to jurisdiction can be taken at any time. "In such a case it is, in fact, the duty of court itself ex mere motu to raise the point even if the parties fail to do so."

rules.statement: A court has a duty to raise an objection to its jurisdiction ex mero motu even if the parties do not raise it.
